title: Fabio (Fabervaale ENG) and friends on CVD and delta: concepts (2026-10-30)
how: Not re-run. Numbers and sentences below were copied from the committed source note; the verdict is the line as written there.

verdict.label: Operator ask, 10-30: find everything Fabio and his channel mates say about using CVD, for BTC and other markets, as concepts.

why: His signal, SOURCED: "you have a negative delta with a positive price action. That's a very clear divergence in market pressure." [9IliXww64uM] He entered on the 5-minute close that confirmed it.
Already measured on BTC 1m, 10-29 drop study: bounce delta share did not change the odds of the low breaking (43% vs 46%). That is a quick test of F-CVD8 at the bounce, and it was a null.
